name: ai-seo
description: Check whether AI answers mention your brand in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, including product recommendations, and check one page for what to change so those answers can quote it accurately. For generative engine optimization (GEO) and AI brand monitoring: track ChatGPT brand mentions and other AI answers with a saved prompt panel in your project and compare each run with the last in an AI visibility report and scorecard: how often you appear, how your business is described (brand accuracy), which sources get cited instead, alerts on drops. In Claude Code, creates or updates llms.txt and AI crawler rules in robots.txt in your project when you ask, showing the diff for each file and asking before replacing existing content, and checks existing ones. Answers come from runs you paste or log, or, if you ask, from this assistant answering the prompts as its own engine; it never contacts ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini or any other outside AI service. Alerts are written into each dated check file, not sent; a recurring check is created in your app only if you ask. Also analyzes citation exports. Contains no code of its own and stores nothing outside your project, apart from a recurring task you ask for; it writes llms.txt, robots.txt or the monitoring folder in your project only when you ask.
